subject: Coordinated purge run: prompt/output/logs — manifest & confirmation
messages:
From: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@datacove.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: purge of prompt logs & generated outputs for tenant datacove-prod

Hi Naomi,

Our security and privacy team needs a full purge of all prompt logs, model outputs, and access logs tied to the datacove-prod tenant (US region). Scope: all prompt text, generated outputs, and associated request logs starting from account creation through 2028-01-31. This is a formal deletion request under our data retention agreement — we need the operation and a signed evidence manifest showing which objects were removed.

Attached is our intake form with the tenant IDs and sample request IDs. Can you confirm the steps, timeline, and what evidence you will provide? We prefer a one-week window but will accept expedited handling if possible.

Attachment: datacove-purge-request.json (intake form)

Thanks,
Alex Lopez
Head of Security, Datacove
alex.lopez@datacove.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@datacove.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Feb 2028 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt logs & generated outputs for tenant datacove-prod

Alex — thank you for the intake. We can run this purge; below is the proposed workflow and required confirmations from your side. Please reply with an explicit approval to proceed or note changes.

High-level workflow (what we'll do):
- Verify tenant identifiers + scope (we used the intake file).
- Produce a dry-run manifest of objects targeted for removal (no deletion in dry run).
- Share dry-run manifest for your review (expected within 24 hours of approval).
- Schedule live purge window (we recommend low-traffic window; see suggested times).
- Execute purge with per-shard evidence (hash list + timestamps).
- Deliver a signed evidence manifest PDF and update audit log entries for your tenancy.

Required from Datacove to proceed:
1) Explicit confirmation: "Approve purge of datacove-prod as scoped in attachment"
2) Preferred purge window (include timezone) or constraint: e.g., no business hours between 08:00–18:00 EST.
3) Confirm whether you require operator screenshots in addition to the manifest (adds ~30 minutes to delivery).

Estimated timeline (after approval):
- Dry-run manifest: within 24 hours
- Review period: 24–48 hours (you can opt to skip review for expedited)
- Live purge: within 72 hours after approval (can be earlier with skip-review)
- Evidence delivery: within 4 hours after completion

Security notes:
- All deletion steps will be executed by an operator in our secure ops pool.
- We keep immutable audit records (access-controlled) for internal compliance; evidence we deliver is sufficient for your SOC2 & privacy review.

Attachments: datacove-purge-request.json (from your email)

Ben and Marissa — please prepare the dry-run manifest generator for datacove-prod and flag any known cross-tenant artifacts.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Feb 2028 13:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt logs & generated outputs for tenant datacove-prod

Naomi — looping ops and scheduling notes.

Dry-run manifest: generated at 2028-02-02T12:30:00Z and attached. Key notes:~
- Total objects identified: 18,720 (prompts + outputs + request traces).
- No cross-tenant references detected in KV cache.
- Two long-tail request traces flagged for manual verification (IDs included in manifest).

Proposed live window: 2028-02-03 05:00–06:00 PST (low traffic) — this will minimize impact.
If Datacove wants operator screenshots, add +30 minutes for evidence capture.

Ops runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/runbooks/purge-execution-v2 (internal)
Dry-run attachment: datacove-dryrun-manifest-20280202.json

Quoting Naomi's ask for explicit confirmation from Alex: 
> "Approve purge of datacove-prod as scoped in attachment"

Marissa — can you schedule an operator and make sure the HSM key used for signing the evidence manifest is available at that time? I will start the runbook checklist and coordinate a brief Slack escalation channel for live updates.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Manager, Customer Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@datacove.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Feb 2028 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompt logs & generated outputs for tenant datacove-prod

Alex — thank you, confirmed receipt of your approval at 2028-02-02T15:08:22-05:00. We executed the live purge during the window 2028-02-03 05:10–05:42 PST. Summary and deliverables below.

Execution summary:
- Objects removed: 18,720 total (prompts: 12,430; outputs: 5,980; request traces: 310).
- Two manual-verification traces were inspected and cleared (IDs: trace-32912, trace-32915).
- No cross-tenant artifacts found.
- Signing key: HSM key HSM-OPS-03 used to sign the manifest.

Delivered evidence:
- purge-evidence-manifest-20280203.pdf (signed, contains SHA256 hashes, per-object timestamps, and operator signature) [attached]
- Audit log entries updated on tenant record and internal immutable audit store (SUP-4821).
- Short operator transcript included in the PDF as appendix (screenshots per your request).

Next steps and retention notes:
- We will keep internal purge execution traces in our immutable store for 90 days for incident review; these traces are not tenant-visible and are access-controlled.
- If you need a notarized statement for compliance, we can schedule a signed letter from Redwood Legal (adds ~3 business days).

Attachment: purge-evidence-manifest-20280203.pdf

If everything looks good, reply with a brief confirmation of acceptance so we can close the ticket.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
